Subject: Follow-up: Security posture & SOC 2 (VPC/on-prem discussion)

Hi Jordan — thanks again for the call today. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we keep momentum: 

Summary from our call:
- Acme is evaluating a private deployment (VPC with strict network isolation) for PII/PHI workloads; HIPAA compliance is required for a subset of traffic.
- You asked about SOC 2 status, GDPR data residency controls, and whether we support air-gapped or on-prem installations.
- You also asked for an architecture diagram showing VPC-only and air-gapped deployment options.

Redwood security posture (short answers):
- SOC 2: Redwood maintains SOC 2 Type II coverage. I’ve attached the SOC 2 attestation (PDF stub) for your security team; we can share the full report under NDA.
- GDPR: We support regionally isolated deployments and data residency controls; encryption at-rest and in-transit by default.
- HIPAA: We offer BAAs; we have controls for PHI handling and can enable restricted logging and retention policies for covered workloads.
- Private/VPC: We support private VPC endpoints, customer-managed subnets, and optional customer KMS. For fully air-gapped/on-prem, we have an on-prem package — will need a short discovery on connectivity and operational constraints.

Requested/next steps:
1) If you can, please attach your vendor security questionnaire (VSQ) or confirm the format (spreadsheet, OneTrust, or Doc). I’ve cc'd Neha (security) and Priyom (solutions) to coordinate.
2) We’ll prepare two artifacts: (a) a concise deployment diagram for VPC + KMS flow and (b) an air-gapped/on-prem sketch with operational notes. Expect first drafts within 48 hours.
3) If you need the SOC 2 report, we can share it under NDA — let us know and we’ll send the link.

Attachments: redwood-soc2-attestation.pdf (attestation stub), redwood-private-deployment-diagram.pdf (initial draft).

Proposed call: Wed, 2026-03-04 at 10:00 AM PT to review diagrams and VSQ answers — does that work on your side?

Thanks — looking forward.

Marcus
